pages.notes: userId and tenantId are server-side scoping only — never rendered. No localStorage writes.
No Protected B fields rendered. Title input sanitized server-side.
Message content in React state only. INT-001 is STUB — Send button always disabled. userId/tenantId not rendered.
All concept name/description fields use MaskedField canUnmask=true. Inline concept-type edits via PATCH body (FAC-S5-024). No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026).
Locked state when no hypothesis. INT-001 STUB — Request Revision disabled. Accept via PATCH body. No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026).
Export format in POST body not URL (FAC-S5-024). Anchor element removed after download click — no persistent blob URL. No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026).
Aggregate stats (patternCount, sessionCount, auditCount) are numeric totals only — no personal data. FAC-S5-025 PASS-N/A. No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026). Access: planner-admin or tenant-admin.

Pattern data is tenant-scoped configuration, not Protected B. Filter params (status, page, sort) safe as query params (FAC-S5-024). FAC-S5-025 PASS-N/A. No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026). INT-002 stub handled.

Dual mode: create (/admin/patterns/new) and edit (/admin/patterns/:patternId). Field values in POST/PUT body (FAC-S5-024). FAC-S5-025 PASS-N/A (pattern config, not Protected B). No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026). TC-052: inputs as controlled React text, no innerHTML. Deactivate = soft-deactivate (BR-008, TC-082, TC-083).

userId resolved to ownerDisplayName via user lookup; raw userId never rendered (FAC-S5-025). User filter holds opaque userRef in component state — not in URL query string (FAC-S5-024). CSV/JSON exports exclude raw userId (TC-043, TC-044). No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026). Access: planner-admin or tenant-admin.

actorId resolved to actorDisplayName via MaskedField; raw actorId never rendered (FAC-S5-025). HMAC chain integrity verified on mount via HmacStatusBanner (TC-045, TC-046). NO edit/delete controls on any row — immutable (BR-014, TC-047). CSV export excludes raw actorId (TC-049). No localStorage writes (FAC-S5-026). Access: planner-admin or tenant-admin.

user.email rendered via MaskedField canUnmask={isTenantAdmin}; planner-admin sees masked email (FAC-S5-025). Email not in URL query strings (FAC-S5-024). Invite form email cleared on close/success (FAC-S5-026). Role change triggers server-side audit event (TC-082, BR-008, SN-012). Access: tenant-admin for writes; planner-admin read-only.

sharedComponents.notes: Verifies HMAC audit chain integrity on mount via api.verifyAuditChain(). Used by AuditLog page. Renders success or emergency GoabxCallout (TC-045, TC-046, BR-014, BR-015, SYSREQ-020).
